# googleworkspace_org_units (Data Source)

Lists every organizational unit in the Workspace account below the root, including empty ones. Compare it against managed `googleworkspace_org_unit` resources to find units created in the Admin console.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_org_units" "all" {}

# Find organizational units created outside of code.
locals {
  managed_ou_ids = [for ou in googleworkspace_org_unit.this : ou.id]
  unmanaged_ous  = [for ou in data.googleworkspace_org_units.all.org_units : ou.org_unit_path if !contains(local.managed_ou_ids, ou.id)]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `org_units` (Attributes List) All organizational units, ordered by path. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--org_units))

<a id="nestedatt--org_units"></a>
### Nested Schema for `org_units`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the organizational unit.
- `id` (String) Immutable organizational unit ID (the `id:...` value). Used for import.
- `name` (String) Name of the organizational unit.
- `org_unit_path` (String) Full path, e.g. `/SMI Board`.
- `parent_org_unit_path` (String) Full path of the parent organizational unit.
